bureau: Centrale des crédits aux particuliers (Banque Nationale de Belgique)
note: The Data Protection Authority's note on the National Bank's credit register: on a credit opening (a card's), a default is registered when an amount due isn't repaid within three months, written as 90 days. Buyway's card terms, under article VII.148 of the Economic Law Code, keep a default twelve months from the contract's regularisation (at most ten years from the first), written as one year.
